notes:
Summary: BrightHelm is evaluating Redwood for a high-scale RAG drive for customer support (primary goal: ticket deflection + reduce live-agent volume). They have ~40M historical tickets, KB articles and product docs to index. Key ask: retrieval+rerank pipeline that hits tight latency SLOs for end-user bot flows.

Requirements / preferences: 
- Workload: primarily support-agent reranking + ticket-deflection funnel (bot first, escalate to agent if confidence low).
- Indexing scale: target initial index ~40M vectors, expected growth 20–30%/yr. Need sharding strategy and cost estimate for 50–100M eventual.
- Latency SLOs: p95 end-to-end (retrieval + reranker) < 250ms for chat UI, p99 target < 450ms. Quote from head of support: "If the bot adds >250ms our CSAT drops noticeably."
- Reranking: must rerank top-50 retrieved to present top-5 best answers. Quality target: >92% correct/deflect for top-5 on benchmark set (they will provide 2k labeled QA pairs).
- Cost: target $0.015–$0.03 per user query (includes retrieval + rerank + embedding cost amortized). Very cost-sensitive; looking to compare Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching, quantization) vs self-hosted ANN.
- Models: prefer verified smaller embed models (768–1536d) for cost and latency tradeoffs. Open to using quantized model variants on Dedicated or on-prem. Want to test Redwood-verified embeddings and a local lightweight reranker (distil-cross-encoder) during POC.
- Data & compliance: PII in tickets; requirement for VPC/private control plane and audit logs. Data residency: must keep EU customer records in EU region.
- Operational needs: TTL for cached results, prefix KV caching for repeated queries, autoscaling strategy for support spikes (release days).

CRM-style fragments / call notes: 
- 2025-02-25: "BrightHelm is metric driven — primary KPI is agent deflection and mean handle time reduction."
- 2025-03-03: Infosec asked for encryption at rest + customer KMS key (they will not accept vendor-managed keys for EU data).
- 2025-03-05: ML team supplied sample 2k eval set; asked Redwood to run reranker A/B with our default cross-encoder vs lighter re-ranker.
- 2025-03-10: Procurement pushed back on committed spend; suggested start with 8-week Dedicated POC with go/no-go before reserved capacity.

Open questions / risks: 
- Can Redwood meet p95 <250ms end-to-end at 40M index with our preferred reranker? Need benchmark on chosen infra.
- Cost math: need detailed per-query breakdown incl. ANN ops, reranker token cost, embedding compute and I/O.
- Legal: confirm data residency approach for EU customers and KMS integration details.

Next short-term actions: 
- Send POC SOW and cost estimate (Marco).
- Provide prelim infra sizing for Dedicated POC (Marco + infra team).
- BrightHelm to share 2k eval set and list of 10 critical queries for latency profiling.
